verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok) search errors, analyze performance, triage issues, and manage projects via natural language, plus a Seer Agent that answers free-form questions about telemetry. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming natural-language command reliability, and more detail on the breadth of commands supported beyond docs claims.
